title: Mo and the Midnight Moon Buggy

beats.chapter: Mo and the Midnight Moon Buggy
beats.text: Mo and the Midnight Moon Buggy
Tonight, {child|little one}, Mo is flying somewhere new. All the way up to the moon.
Up here there is a long, bumpy road, and on it, a little moon buggy. Brrm... brrm... putt.
Its headlights are fading. It has lost its way home, and the moon is nearly asleep.
Mo has an idea. We can help the buggy find its garage.
Make a dog: a flat hand, thumb up for an ear, and your little finger down for its mouth.
A moon dog! Good at sniffing out the way. Climb on, Mo.
Sniff, sniff, along the road. The little buggy follows behind.
The dog found the right road, and sits down for a rest.
Oh no. A big crater, right in the middle of the road. How will the buggy get across?
Make a bird with two hands, side by side. Fly up high to look for a way around.
Up, up, over the crater. Look, there is a smooth path around the edge.
The buggy rolls slowly round the crater. Brrm, brrm. The bird waves its wings goodbye.
Now it is very dark, and the headlights are only a tiny glow. The buggy needs a little light.
Look! A small star is falling, just for us.
Cup your hands together, softly, and catch it.
You caught it. Shine it on the road, so the buggy can see the way home.
Now open your hands, and let the star light the way.
And there it is. The little garage, with its door open.
The buggy rolls inside, safe and sound. Its headlights blink once, twice, and go softly out.
Goodnight, little buggy. Goodnight, moon. And goodnight, {child|little one}. Mo will see you tomorrow.
The End
The End
